ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 95:5 low-to-high intensity ratio; the majority of the fluke surface presents as low-intensity dark pixels with high-intensity pixels isolated to peripheral regions.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Uniform dark-pixel distribution across proximal and medial lobe areas. High-contrast white/beige pixel clusters are confined to the lateral distal tips of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression at the central midline; calculated pixel angle approximately 68-72 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration map across the entire trailing boundary. Vertical amplitude of jagged pixel variations ranges from 3 to 15 pixels relative to the lobe body.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetric concave curvature along the posterior margins, tapering to sharp points at the distal horizontal extremities.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast, roughly circular white pixel clusters localized at the left and right distal tips, indicating high-relief surface attachments.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive calcified colonization patterns on the distal edges and tips of both lobes, disrupting the smooth trailing edge line.
